rationale: Materialize CAV2-D65 revision 2 as a prototype-first machine contract with non-authoritative ontology scaffolds, deterministic candidate freezing, exact product-test evidence, and computed request eligibility.
migration_impact: The revision-2 surface is parallel and additive. Legacy revision-1 ConstructionBinding records and receipts remain preserved but cannot satisfy the new evaluator.
rollback: Remove only the revision-2 prototype registries, schemas, evaluator, tests, receipt, profile fields, and this witness while no product approval or post-approval request references them. Preserve all revision-1 evidence.
claim_ceiling: Machine-checkable prototype consistency and request eligibility only; no product approval, authority, admission, activation, cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
